goal: Give every UOR Foundation repository the tier GOVERNANCE.md 5 defines for what it is, keeping a tier its maintainers already recorded.

app.name: uor-repo-tier
app.title: Repository tier by use case
app.purpose: Decide a UOR Foundation repository's tier from the tier tag it already carries, if any, and otherwise from its use case as GOVERNANCE.md 5 classifies it.

fields.name: recorded
fields.means: the tier its single tier topic tag records, or none when it carries no single tier tag

fields.name: role
fields.means: the repository's use case: core framework, critical specification, implementation, integration, documentation, website, presentation, or early experiment

meanings.t1: Tier 1: core framework and critical specs, strong review and verification
meanings.t2: Tier 2: implementations and integrations, standard review and CI
meanings.t3: Tier 3: docs, websites and presentation repos, basic review and CI
meanings.t4: Tier 4: early experiments, clear status and basic hygiene

properties.why: a tier its maintainers recorded is never overridden by the use case
an early experiment is never Tier 1 unless its maintainers record it

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Records the tier of a repository and needs the proposed tier to follow GOVERNANCE.md 5 and to yield to the tier already recorded.

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Holds final governance authority and needs every repository classified by the same published rule.

stakeholders.name: Adopter
stakeholders.text: Chooses which UOR Foundation repositories to depend on and reads the tier as the controls a repository promises.

components.name: GitHub repository settings
components.text: The topics, rulesets, names and files of each UOR-Foundation repository.

components.name: Remediation register
components.text: remediation/project.mjs and remediation/register.json in UOR-Foundation/community, which project each repository's change set from the decision apps.

threats.name: Tier understated to escape controls
threats.text: A core framework or critical spec is proposed as Tier 3 or 4 so that it needs fewer reviews and no required files.

control.name: Use case decides
control.text: A framework or spec with no recorded tier is Tier 1.

threats.name: Recorded tier overwritten
threats.text: A remediation replaces the tier tag a maintainer recorded.

control.name: Recorded tier kept
control.text: Any recorded tier is the answer, whatever the use case.

quality.text: Each row of the GOVERNANCE.md 5 classification table is reached by a rule.
quality.measureText: Rows of GOVERNANCE.md 5 with no rule.
